difficultyRationale: Requires connecting encounter order with the semantics of the short-circuiting findFirst terminal operation.
prompt: For an ordered stream with elements `a`, `b`, `c`, what does `findFirst()` promise when the stream is non-empty?
explanation: `findFirst` returns an Optional describing the first element of the stream. On an ordered stream, that means the first element in encounter order.

options.text: It returns an Optional containing a.
options.explanation: a is first in the stream's encounter order.

options.text: It may return any element even though the stream is ordered.
options.explanation: That freedom belongs to findAny; findFirst respects encounter order when one exists.

options.text: It returns all three elements in a List.
options.explanation: findFirst is a short-circuiting terminal operation returning one Optional.

options.text: It can be used only on sequential streams.
options.explanation: findFirst also works on parallel streams while preserving first-element semantics for ordered streams.
